name: eMudhra

snapshot.about: eMudhra provides digital trust, identity, cybersecurity, and certificate lifecycle management solutions internationally.

narrative: Management targets ambitious top-line expansion and consistent PAT growth, backed by reported revenues and solid segment contributions like Cryptas. While operational metrics display strong sequential momentum, longer-term guidance remains open pending future financial verification.

cash.read: Despite solid reported profits and operating cash flows in recent years, free cash flow remains negative over the broader five-year period due to heavy capital outlays.

bull.point: Robust revenue and income expansion driven by solid performance in enterprise solutions and trust services.

evidence.quote: Net profit for the year has increased from INR 872.34 million to INR 1,100.38 million on a consolidated basis
We closed the year with a total income of INR7,132 million, up 35% year-on-year
During the quarter, our total income grew by 28% YoY to INR 1,925 million

bull.point: Strong order book visibility supporting forward guidance and international segment contributions.

evidence.quote: Our current ratio in the fiscal stood at 2.9 times (average basis) consolidated, which measures our ability to pay short- term obligation
And with the 238 crores order book that we have called out
Cryptas contributed approximately INR 200 million of revenue during what is typically a seasonally weak quarter in Europe

bear.point: Negative free cash flow historically despite growing reported net profits.
